questions.q: Why should a study plan start by mapping existing path work against the exam's published objectives?
options: Because the exam objectives are always identical to this course's lesson titles
Because large parts of a Financials certification's objectives are likely already familiar from this path's courses and the capstone, so the plan should focus on actual gaps
Because mapping objectives has no real purpose and is just busywork
Because Oracle requires a signed mapping document before exam registration
questions.explain: Since the path already covers GL, AP, AR, Assets, Cash Management, SLA, and a full capstone close, much of a Financials exam's objectives are probably already familiar - so the plan should target specific remaining gaps.

questions.q: Which weekly study structure does this lesson recommend as more sustainable?
options: One long cram session the weekend before the exam
Studying only the night before, since spacing doesn't matter
Two to three shorter sessions a week (45-60 minutes), alternating review with hands-on rebuilding
Watching videos exclusively with no hands-on practice at all
questions.explain: Spaced, shorter sessions that alternate objective review with hands-on rebuilding are recommended over a single long cram session, for better retention.

questions.q: What is the real purpose of a practice exam, according to this lesson's three-question readiness check?
options: It is the entire study plan by itself
It replaces the need to ever configure anything hands-on
It guarantees a passing score on the real exam
It is a readiness check that reveals where gaps remain - it does not fill those gaps itself
questions.explain: A practice exam score tells you where you're weak. It does not teach you the material - that still requires hands-on review and practice.

questions.q: What should you do once you've honestly answered yes to all three readiness-check questions?
options: Schedule the real exam only through Oracle's own current registration process, never through a third party claiming a shortcut
Pay for leaked or 'guaranteed' exam content from an online seller
Skip the real exam entirely and claim the certification anyway
Wait an additional two years regardless of readiness
questions.explain: Scheduling should always go through Oracle's own current, legitimate process. Leaked or 'guaranteed' content violates Oracle's certification agreement and can invalidate results.

questions.q: Why does this lesson recommend keeping a list of specific gaps rather than a vague sense of what to review?
options: Vague feelings about weak areas are not specific enough to actually study effectively, unlike a concrete, named gap
Specific gap lists are required by Oracle for exam registration
Vague review is always more effective than targeted review
Gap lists have no effect on study outcomes either way
questions.explain: A specific gap (like 'not confident on secondary ledger use cases') can actually be studied and closed, unlike a vague feeling such as 'I should review GL again.'
